Names in the records
Arba Lorenzo Lambson
Born
November 24, 1818 · Royalton, Niagara County, New York
Died
1870 · Bartlett, Fremont County, Iowa

Captained overland wagon companies in 1861 and 1862. Died in Bartlett, Iowa, in 1870, as confirmed by the archive owner from FamilySearch.

Arba Lorenzo Lambson captained overland wagon companies in 1861 and 1862. He married Elizabeth Bonner in 1836 and Sarah Cordellia Harrington in 1854. The archive owner confirmed the FamilySearch death year and location: 1870 in Bartlett, Iowa.
